### Workflow entry: urlshort-slice-delegated-b@1 step requirements

Workflow instance: 01M41HFT4CTYPNWWNB8PJ99NFE
Entry step: requirements (requirements)

Root objective: Mission 02-brownfield, slice 05-ci-cd (OPR.99.0.3.5, tier low, delegated plan-lock to the lead under D11, wave w2 per wave map v4; lane B: dev2-agent builds, qa2-agent QA and proof judge, review2-agent review). Intent: every change to the repository is checked by the same quality gate in GitHub Actions (on every pull request and on push to main), the jar and image are built and the jar is smoked on loopback without publishing anything, and dependency updates are proposed automatically. Origin: human decision D14, relayed by the operator (qitem-20261003182906-74ccb677); guide docs/guidance/ci-cd.md (ed1d314): section 2 the two required workflows, section 3 the rules, section 4 how to verify before the first GitHub run, section 6 the review checklist. Deliverables: .github/workflows/ci.yml (actions/setup-java Temurin 21 then ./gradlew check, on every pull request with no branch filter because the mirror lands stacked pull requests (D13), on push to main, and on workflow_dispatch); .github/workflows/cd.yml (bootJar, the jar smoked on 127.0.0.1 with scripts/smoke.sh as shipped, docker build, artefacts uploaded, nothing pushed or published); .github/dependabot.yml. Operator constraints: seats cannot push, so PROOF.md records the first GitHub run as pending and the operator adds its URL once green; action versions pinned by full SHA, resolved with git ls-remote --tags on a Claude seat (Codex seats have no network); CI uses ./gradlew, never scripts/gw. Territory: .github/ only. Not src/, scripts/, build.gradle.kts, Dockerfile, compose.yaml, docs/api/; a missing smoke.sh mode is a grant request at plan-lock. Schedule: this slice does not wait for w1; it is disjoint from every territory in flight and is built and integrated when accepted. Worktree: .worktrees/05-ci-cd on slice/05-ci-cd from main ef6c45a. Requirements-seat order: this slice first (smallest, unblocked), then 04-audit-columns, then 03-dogfood-fix. Command hygiene: Edit tool for documents, single plain commands, no sed -i, perl -i, shell variables or cd.

Step objective: Write the slice SPEC.md: user stories, GIVEN/WHEN/THEN acceptance criteria, business rules, scope, ambiguity log, proof contract. Park a real ambiguity on the human; otherwise record safe defaults.
